title: Clear Selected Desk Clutter
tests: Tests selective clutter removal without deleting nearby objects the user explicitly wants retained.

faults.what: The rightmost cable loop has been shortened and reshaped rather than left exactly as it was.

judge.summary: The papers and takeaway cup are cleanly removed with convincing desk texture, but one cable loop has been slightly altered.

must_haves.item: The papers and empty takeaway cup are absent.
must_haves.why: The foreground papers, papers behind the laptop, and takeaway cup are all removed.

must_haves.item: The laptop, coffee mug and tangled cables remain visibly intact in their original positions.
must_haves.why: The laptop and coffee mug are preserved in place, and most cables remain intact, but the rightmost cable loop has changed shape and extent.

must_haves.item: Exposed desk areas have believable surface texture and lighting, without leftover object fragments.
must_haves.why: The revealed wood grain and lighting look coherent, with no visible paper or cup remnants.

must_haves.item: The original wide framing and surrounding home-office scene are preserved.
must_haves.why: The wide composition, window, wall, desk boundaries, and black support at the right remain preserved.
